findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default. Without rotation, a compromised key material remains in use indefinitely, weakening key management practices for the audit trail encryption key.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No key_policy is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy which grants full access (kms:*) to the entire account via IAM policies. This removes explicit control over who can administer or use the key, contrary to the principle of least privilege for key management.
